**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2 (p0013)**

Section 2.2 makes Silverline our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — unlimited-duration exclusivity with no performance-based exit, which is walk-away territory under EXCLUSIVITY and fails the fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic termination on SLA/delivery failure). It also directly contradicts Section 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment), so the clause is internally inconsistent as drafted.

Redline (validated, preferred position): Vendor becomes "a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services," with express confirmation that we may procure the same or similar services from any third party at any time. The comment offers the category/12-month/performance-exit fallback if Silverline needs some protection.
